en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a calm river with a single rower in a narrow boat, long timber logs floating and stacked along the near bank, and a dirt path lined with tall pollarded trees on the right. In the middle distance there is a steel truss bridge crossing the river, with buildings and additional bridge structures visible beyond it. The scene appears semi‑rural/industrial with no printed caption visible on the image.
